name: salonbook-backend
description: Portable single-file Node.js + Express + MongoDB/Mongoose + JWT + Stripe + ImgBB REST API backend for SalonBook

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {validatePassword,validateServiceInput,validateAppointmentDate,createSeedData,filterAndSortServices,hasBookingConflict} from './index.js';assert.equal(validatePassword('Ab1').valid,false);assert.equal(validatePassword('Secret1').valid,true);assert.equal(validateAppointmentDate('2020-01-01','2026-11-18').valid,false);assert.equal(validateAppointmentDate('2026-02-31','2026-11-18').valid,false);assert.equal(validateAppointmentDate('2026-11-20','2026-11-18').valid,true);assert.equal(createSeedData({includeDemo:false}).services.length,0);assert.equal(validateServiceInput({serviceName:'Balayage',category:'Hair Coloring',description:'Hand-painted dimensional color ritual.',price:210,duration:120,image:'/img.jpg'}).valid,true);assert.equal(filterAndSortServices([{id:'1',serviceName:'A',status:'active',price:50,createdAt:'2026-10-01'},{id:'2',serviceName:'B',status:'inactive',price:20,createdAt:'2026-10-02'}]).length,1);assert.equal(hasBookingConflict([{id:'a',serviceId:'s1',customerId:'c1',appointmentDate:'2026-11-20',timeSlot:'09:00 AM',status:'confirmed'}],{serviceId:'s1',customerId:'c2',appointmentDate:'2026-11-20',timeSlot:'09:00 AM'}).conflict,true);console.log('Backend unit checks passed');"
